title: Dynamic Mycelium Map
definition: The concept of creating a dynamically updating mycelium map that stays current with the blockstore data.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine you're building a digital map that updates itself automatically every time new information is added.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The dynamic mycelium map is a graph-based visualization tool that updates in real-time to reflect the current state of the blockstore data.
difficulty_levels.expert: The dynamic mycelium map is a novel approach that combines data visualization with blockchain technology to create a living knowledge graph.

extra_fields.insight: The fix isn't 'finding the old generator' — it's 'building the generator that should have existed.'
